Chapter 710: Chapter 13 Two-dimensional World (Subscribe Please)

In a daze,

Lin Yuan finally came to his senses.

“Where is this?”

Lin Yuan looked around, realizing he was lying in a narrow room.

“Me?”

Lin Yuan rubbed his brow. Just before losing consciousness, he had seen a ‘White Paper’.

...

A ‘White Paper’ that had squeezed in from the Eternal Spatial Rift.

Then afterwards.

Lin Yuan felt a violent change in space-time, as if some pivot was collapsing.

“What exactly happened?”

Lin Yuan re-established contact with his True Body, and he breathed a sigh of relief.

“Not right.”

Lin Yuan’s expression suddenly turned grave.

“Where are the Spatial Layers?”

“And the fluctuations of many rules?”

Lin Yuan couldn’t believe that, at this moment, he couldn’t feel any rule fluctuations at all.

And the Spatial Layers? He couldn’t detect even a trace of the Space Rules, nor any Spatial Layers.

It was as if this world had only a very thin layer of space.

But how could that be possible?

If there were no Spatial Layers, it meant the world was incomplete.

How could an incomplete world possibly accommodate the arrival of a Tenth Rank Life like him?

Even if it could barely contain him, with just a thought, he should be able to tear everything apart, yet now, Lin Yuan felt no such ability.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s frowned deepened.

“The fluctuations from many spaces are still there, the Spatial Layers are still there.”

Lin Yuan doubted internally, why couldn’t he feel any fluctuations of the Space Rules where the Taiyang Divine Spirit was?

You must know, time and space are the basic pillars of the spatial world, other rule fluctuations can be blocked or suppressed.

But time and space cannot be suppressed.

Just like in the space inside the black planet, one can only feel the corresponding Fusion Rules fluctuations, but aside from that, faint space fluctuations are still perceivable.

“Supreme Being.”

Lin Yuan immediately contacted the Supreme Being.

“You and all the lives on the battlefield have fallen into that White Paper,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said directly upon seeing Lin Yuan.

“Everything near that White Paper will ‘downgrade’ itself, only Twelfth-Rank Life can resist it,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said, “But don’t worry, I am trying to see if I can fish you out.”

“Thank you, Supreme Being.”

Lin Yuan roughly figured out the situation of the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

…

Inside the White Paper scroll.

Lin Yuan’s thoughts spread.

“I am now inside that White Paper, forcibly downgraded, no wonder I can’t feel any rule fluctuations,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“Even my Inner World has been directly compressed into a plane…” Lin Yuan examined himself, noticing that his Inner World had completely vanished, leaving behind only a slight trace.

“My physical body, my power, my soul, all have been forcibly reduced to a very low level,” Lin Yuan sensed carefully, his expression grave.

“However… the Door to the Myriad Realms is still there…” Lin Yuan’s consciousness sank into his mind, looking at the still majestic and imposing Door to the Myriad Realms.

Even in this two-dimensional world inside the White Paper, the Door to the Myriad Realms still exuded a supreme presence, unaffected by anything.

“A two-dimensional world?”

This was the first time Lin Yuan had encountered such a world.

In the past, through the nine transits via the Door to the Myriad Realms, although all were to other dimensions,

the levels of the dimensions he transited to were all on the same level as the Main Universe. As for lower dimensions, Lin Yuan had not encountered them.

“That White Paper can automatically cause everything nearby to downgrade to two-dimensional, the Chaos Void is indeed wonderful, possessing even such strange objects.”

Lin Yuan was not panicked, instead awaiting the Supreme Being’s response.

In fact, if he hadn’t invested a large amount of resources on this Taiyang Divine Spirit, Lin Yuan would now be inclined to directly annihilate this avatar and leave.

But being fished out by the Supreme Being would naturally be a better outcome.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan waited for a moment.

He met with Xia Qin Supreme Being again.

Compared to the initial calmness, Xia Qin Supreme Being now appeared solemn.

“Things are a bit troublesome.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan and spoke gravely, “That ‘White Paper’ is of too high level, we can’t refine or interfere with it.”

The implication was,

that they couldn’t fish Lin Yuan out.

“Then I will just abandon that avatar,”

Lin Yuan immediately spoke.

Although he was quite curious about the two-dimensional world inside that White Paper,

without knowing specific details, Lin Yuan naturally didn’t dare to stay there for long.

What if he encountered the Causal Curse Killing force of the Cosmic Aurora? Wouldn’t that be even more troublesome?

Although the Cosmic Aurora could only curse kill life below Tenth Rank, and Lin Yuan had left a lot of essence blood in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm,

By leveraging the Xuanhuang Secret Realm’s ability to isolate causality, even a Supreme Being’s curse kill could be easily resisted.

But who could clarify the matters of the Chaos Void?

So it was better to leave sooner rather than later.

A wise man does not stand under a dangerous wall.

“Don’t do that,” Xia Qin Supreme Being shook his head, “Different Species have already tried that, exploding avatars that fell into the White Paper.”

“But the result…”

The Supreme Being paused for a while and continued, “We found those exploded avatars can never be restored.”

“Eternally irrecoverable?”

Lin Yuan was startled.

The essence of creating avatars involved severing a part of one’s spirit will and then using it as a core to generate a second physical body.

For any being, the spirit will is the most crucial part, as only those from the same spirit will can achieve shared memories and consciousness.

To maintain the connection between the severed spirit will and the original self.

The total amount of spirit will is fixed.

For instance, a Tenth Rank being has a spirit will of ten points.

If they sever two points of spirit will to create an avatar,

then henceforth, the original body’s spirit will would be eight points.

The avatar’s spirit will would be two points.

If another two points of spirit will are severed to form a second avatar,

then the original self’s spirit will would be reduced to six points.

Each of the two avatars would have two points of spirit will.

This is why most powerful beings have only one avatar.

The more avatars are formed, the weaker the original self’s spirit will becomes.

And the weakening of one’s spirit will affect everything, from understanding the rules to the functioning of one’s own combat power, and so on.

The decline is quite severe.

If an avatar perishes outside,

then the original self’s spirit will is restored.

And then one could continue to sever the spirit will to create avatars.

But did Xia Qin Supreme Being mean that the avatar self-destructed within the two-dimensional world inside White Paper would be lost forever?

Does that mean the spirit will carried by the avatar can’t be recovered and the original self permanently loses part of its spirit will?

In a flash.

Lin Yuan immediately realized what this meant.

Devastating.

The cost is simply too devastating.

Permanently losing a portion of one’s spirit will could seriously demote a powerful being’s potential and strength by several levels.

Although creating an avatar also requires severing a part of the spirit will, as long as the avatar is reclaimed, this portion of the spirit will can be restored.

But now?

Eternally irrecoverable?

“I…”

Lin Yuan thought of himself.

If the Taiyang Divine Spirit dies in the two-dimensional world inside White Paper,

does that mean he can’t recondense this divine spirit either?

And the Taiyin Primordial Spirit and Taiyang Primordial Spirit are Lin Yuan’s foundation in Martial Tao, supporting his grand Martial Tao.

Permanently losing the Taiyang Primordial Spirit would severely affect Lin Yuan’s Martial Arts Evolution System.

With only the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, the Martial Tao would become imbalanced between Yin and Yang, and could potentially collapse.

…

“Door to the Myriad Realms.”

In the two-dimensional world inside White Paper, Lin Yuan’s consciousness immediately plunged into his mind, looking toward that majestic Door to the Myriad Realms.

If his spirit will enters the Door to the Myriad Realms and arrives in the world of another dimension, waiting for the Taiyang Primordial Spirit to die in the two-dimensional world so that this spirit will can return to his true self,

then could it avoid the permanent loss effect of the Taiyang Primordial Spirit?

Lin Yuan wasn’t sure; this method could only be used as a last resort.

“The best choice, naturally, is to escape from this two-dimensional world, but how to escape?” Lin Yuan’s thoughts fluctuated.

The supreme beings of human civilization know nothing about that ‘White Paper’; the only certainty is that it’s associated with the Taiyuan Relic.

“Right.”

“Ask them.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts slightly moved.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness incarnation descended there.

“Master,” a Six-Armed Silhouette bowed slightly to Lin Yuan, respectfully saying.

“Do you know about this ‘White Paper’?” Lin Yuan didn’t waste words, simply manifesting the appearance of the ‘White Paper’.

The Six-Armed Silhouette was the spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, created by Xuanhuang, and definitely knew much more than the supreme beings of human civilization.

After all, Xuanhuang was a powerful being renowned even in the Chaos Void.

“This ‘White Paper’ contains a two-dimensional world; nearby materials will be forcefully reduced in dimension and plunge into the White Paper,” Lin Yuan tried to convey everything he had learned.

“Two-dimensional world?”

“White Paper?”

The Six-Armed Silhouette was momentarily taken aback.

“Is master talking about ‘Low-dimensional Space’?” the Six-Armed Silhouette said immediately.”

“Low-dimensional Space?” Lin Yuan’s spirits lifted, “Please explain in detail.”

“Yes.” The Six-Armed Silhouette didn’t dare to hesitate, perceiving the importance of this to Lin Yuan.

“Low-dimensional space, according to the few records obtained by His Majesty from a perilous place,”

the Six-Armed Silhouette hurriedly said:

“Low-dimensional space is an artifact created by beings close to Perfect Time Beings to explore other dimensional spaces.”

“However, later, some powerful beings found out that low-dimensional space allows two lives of different strengths to start from the same beginning. A sliver of spirit will in the form of an avatar descends into the low-dimensional space, needing to start from scratch.”

“Discarding everything, starting fresh, without the influence of lineage, without the influence of secret techniques, without the influence of understanding the rules, thus, the greatest use of low-dimensional space is to test ‘aptitude.'”

“At the same starting point, under the same environment, within a fixed time, whoever’s strength improves the fastest, indicates who has the strongest aptitude.”

“Eventually, low-dimensional space became a sort of entertainment, life forms of different levels often divide a sliver of spirit will to engage in a battle within the low-dimensional space.”

As the Six-Armed Silhouette spoke, it paused and seemed to be recalling something, “Of course, there are two types of low-dimensional space.”

“One is a purely recreational low-dimensional space, with no restrictions.”

“The other is a gamble-style low-dimensional space; this type of low-dimensional space has many rules, and leaving midway carries a severe penalty. Of course, if you defeat your opponent in the end, you would receive a substantial reward.”

The Six-Armed Silhouette spoke with a hint of nostalgia:

“His Majesty once said, the ultimate winner in low-dimensional space would win everything.”
